    (t:Caps m)(ht:∀ i,t i ≤ D)(w:Ribbon (Bel C.book) t)(he:m ≤ n):∃ κ:ℝ,∀ᶠ k:ℕ in atTop, ∀ Y,Poised P B H O J n z k Y→
       (wok C D k (P x).arc χ Y).inspection F (κ*Ship.budget (A) n k) (Scaling.window (2*R) m) ht w:=by

proof_context.conclusion: For poised `Y` at all late `k`, the lift `wok` satisfies `inspection` on `Scaling.window (2*R) m` with error `κ*Ship.budget A n k`, where `Ship.budget = exp(-log(monitor k)/(16 n))`.

have he : ∀ s,s.val.Nonempty → (Ship.yard C b (show k ≤ N from hj.le) p).rootTest (C.beta N p) (fun U=> (Ship.invoice (jointX (d0:=fun i=> (I i).val) v) W hf N p U).part s) ≤ Ship.budget (A) n k:=
          he Y hY N p hj y (h2.symm ▸ hi) hf
       have hr:∀ i,Interior _ (Read.probes C N p k (Next.Rank.Station.choose (A) b k y) W i):= fun i => (hx i).choose_spec p i (a i)
       have hu:= Read.full_cost H (Ship.fitting hf) (Ship.budget_pos (A) n k).le (Ship.yard C b (show k≤N from hj.le) p) hr he
       have hy : O' y ≤ c:= hc (mem_image_of_mem _ hi)
       have hm:= (Ship.budget_pos (A) n k).le
       change Next.Rank.Station.choose A b k y=i at h1; change Next.Rank.Station.tested A b k y=y at h2; rw [h1,h2] at hu
       change ‖C.numeric N p W (fun x=>Cells.location C.S k N p (i x))-disc (hang t w) (tag Q.spacing i)‖ ≤ _
       rw [show Q.spacing=μ⁻¹ from wok_spacing ..]
       -- ht disc equality.
       refine le_trans (show ‖_ - disc (hang t w) y‖ ≤ O' y * Ship.budget (A) n k from ?_) ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hy hm).trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right hε.le)); rw [← hW]; exact hu

proof_context.conclusion: The proof bounds every nonempty subset part of `Ship.invoice` by `Ship.budget` in `rootTest` on the yard tiling, checks the stencils are `Interior`, and applies `Read.full_cost` with the constant `sup O'` of the free profile on the window.

theorem full_cost (h : C.Makes) (hx : x∈conf n) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0≤η) (T : Tiling (C.side N p))
    (hp : ∀ i, Interior (T.chamber 0) (probes C N p k u t i))
    (he : ∀ s : modes (Fin n),s.val.Nonempty → T.rootTest (C.beta N p)
      (fun U => (cylinder (cumulants C x B hx) (probes C N p k u t) U).part s) ≤ η) :
    ‖C.numeric N p t (fun i => Cells.location C.S k N p (u i)) -
      (standard C).useAt (standard C) x B‖ ≤ Poly.price (fun _ => 1) (maxProfile C x B) * η := by

proof_context.conclusion: If all subset parts of the cumulant cylinder have `rootTest ≤ η`, the numeric moment differs from the Maxwell value by at most `price(maxProfile) * η`.
